transcript.text: Our Bosch dryer keeps stopping with the empty water container light on but the container is empty?? We've emptied it like 5 times

To help me guide you to the right part or check without guessing, could you please check the model number? It is usually on a sticker inside the door opening or on the back of the machine.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
I can't get to the back, it's stacked on the washer with a tower kit. The manual cover says it starts WTG8 but that's all I've got. Is that enough?

Yes, that is enough to proceed. Since the container is empty but the light stays on, it is very likely the sensor inside isn't detecting it correctly. Please take the water container out again, wash it under a tap (including the lid area), and check for any small white plastic 'float' inside or near the opening—make sure it moves freely. Then push it back in firmly until you hear a click. Does the light go off after doing this?

Done that, washed the container and the filter bit was slimy so I cleaned it. I didn't see any white float thing. It clicks in firmly but I'm not sure the light has gone off for good, it keeps stopping mid-cycle.

[Heading: Likely cause: float switch]
Because this involves internal components and electrical parts, you will need a qualified engineer to replace the condensate pump assembly.

Blocked condensate pump or sump (fluff sludge) (medium)
